channel.title: Violations Watch: Chad
channel.description: New incidents reported in Chad. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Drone strike in a contested gold-mining area of northwest Chad on 17 Nov kills at least one civilian; a local militia blames the strike on a government-aligned force (African Insider)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tibesti region, Chad. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Government-aligned force, according to a local militia (not confirmed). Reported casualties: 1+ killed. Disputed or caveats: Attribution comes from a local militia, a party to the dispute; not independently verified. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1178
